# Draft:The Eternal king (Youtuber)

----
Overview
The Eternal king is a youtuber who posts a variety of content but, most notably he plays on fortnite. He joined YouTube on April 24th 2023.
History
He started off with making videos on his Europe trip and also the game suicide squad.
His YouTube name was originally God Of Otters with a dog for a profile picture.
